consequence.statement: Istio resources now include standardized Kubernetes recommended labels; label selectors, filters, and monitoring rules that depend on these labels being absent or different may be affected.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds the Kubernetes recommended labels app.kubernetes.io/name, app.kubernetes.io/instance, app.kubernetes.io/part-of, app.kubernetes.io/version, app.kubernetes.io/managed-by, and helm.sh/chart to almost all resources.
